description: This C# source file defines a class 'HelloWorld1Snippet' that generates a PDF snippet showcasing different font selections, styles, decorations, and measurements using the PDFsharp library. It contains multiple conditional compilation sections to demonstrate various font features and used external references related to PDF rendering and font management.
